ghi_chu: Noi dung chi co dieu 2 pham vi ap dung, khong co dau hieu quan he; tieu de nguon hep hon (cua khau) so voi dich (viec nhap khau noi chung)
Tieu de nguon va dich GIONG HET NHAU (Quy dinh cap ky thuat duong thuy noi dia), cung co quan - mau tai ban toan bo thay the rat pho bien o VN
Tieu de giong het nhau (bo sung danh muc du an vay von) - co the la chuoi bo sung dinh ky, khong ro la thay the hay chi la doc lap
Pham vi nguon (xe co gioi noi chung) va dich (xe o to tham gia GT + da qua su dung NK) khac nhau ro, khong co bang chung lien ket
Tieu de gan nhu trung khop hoan toan voi dich (che do bao cao truc tuyen va quan ly van hanh he thong thong tin...) - loai tai ban thay the
Nguon tuyen bo ro bai bo 28 VB toan bo + 2 VB mot phan theo Phu luc 6 (KHONG duoc trich xuat) - rat co the dich nam trong danh sach do
Dieu 17 co dieu khoan chuyen tiep goi y co thay the that, nhung Dieu 1 (danh sach bien phap lam sinh cu the) bi cat, khong xac nhan duoc dich co trong danh sach khong
Nghi dinh sua nhieu NĐ cung luc (thong tin truyen thong/xuat ban), chi trich duoc Dieu 5-6 (hieu luc thi hanh) - Dieu sua doi cu the cho dich co the bi thieu
Tieu de GIONG HET (Huong dan quyet toan von dau tu); noi dung trich duoc chi la 1 bieu mau/form, khong phai dieu khoan van hanh that
Chuyen tu phi/le phi sang gia dich vu (theo Luat Phi va le phi 2015) la mau chuyen doi che do co that giai doan 2016+, nhung suy luan cua DeepSeek qua gian tiep
Cung mau chuyen doi phi/le phi -> gia dich vu nam 2016 (thay 1 loat TT huong dan thu phi cu), cung linh vuc thu nghiem khi thai
Chu de kha khac nhau (thu tuc mot cua vs quan ly cap phep internet), khong du bang chung ro rang ca 2 huong
Chu de trung khop hoan toan (le phi qua lai bien gioi dat lien VN-lang gieng), 'ngung thu' = hieu qua tuong duong bai bo muc thu cu
Nguon hep hon dich ve pham vi (chi xet thang hang vs ca thi+xet+hinh thuc...), khong ro la thay toan bo hay chi 1 phan
Nguon tu noi ro can cu Nghi dinh 40/2014 (khac han TTLT 21/2015 dich) - bang chung dan chieu truc tiep ung ho KhongLienQuan
2 loai phi khac nhau ro rang (tham dinh vien thong vs quan ly chat luong buu dien) du cung linh vuc vien thong
2 loai phi thuy san khac nhau (quan ly CL/an toan/thu y vs bao ve nguon loi), pham vi dieu chinh khac nhau that
Mau tai ban mau ho so moi thau tu van dinh ky cua BKH/BKHDT - loai van ban thuong thay the toan bo mau cu
Nguon pham vi rong hon (cho bien gioi voi TAT CA nuoc chung bien gioi) thay cho quy che rieng VN-Lao - mau hop nhat/mo rong pho bien
Dieu 2 neu ro dieu khoan van hanh ve lai suat cho vay - phu hop voi viec sua doi phan lai suat cho vay trong dich rong hon
Tieu de trung khop hoan toan nhung noi dung trich (dieu kien ap dung thue suat cho 1 truong hop cu the) co the la bo sung dieu kien, khong han la thay the
Nguon sua nhieu TT cung luc (thi dua khen thuong,...), chi trich duoc Dieu 4 ve tuyen chon de tai KH (linh vuc khac) - dieu lien quan thi dua co the bi thieu trich xuat
DeepSeek trich dan cu the 'Dieu 21 bai bo toan bo' va Dieu 21 CO trong cau truc component nhung noi dung RONG (khong duoc trich xuat) - rat dang ngo
Nguon ban hanh Danh muc thuoc BVTV MOI hoan toan, thay toan bo cac danh muc/sua doi truoc do (mau tai ban danh muc pho bien)
Noi dung trich cho thay nguon (cap quoc gia) chi la tai lieu tham khao cho cac don vi to chuc thi CAP CO SO - khac cap voi dich, ho tro KhongLienQuan
Tieu de GIONG HET dich (Quy dinh cua khau NK o to duoi 16 cho ngoi), cung co quan - mau tai ban dinh ky cua khau
Nguon co nhieu Dieu 'Thay the Phu luc X bang Phu luc Y' cho nhieu TT khac nhau - Dieu cu the danh cho dich co the nam ngoai phan trich
Noi dung trich (thu tuc dang ky thu vien tu nhan) khac han chu de dich (di san van hoa) - khong ro huong nao
Giong Dieu 132170 khac (#18-2-b) - cung 1 cap NĐ da nganh, Dieu cu the cho dich co the bi thieu trich xuat
Tieu de GIONG HET dich (Huong dan ve phi va le phi thuoc tham quyen HDND) - mau tai ban dinh ky pho bien
Tieu de nguon ve chuc nang/nhiem vu don vi (hanh chinh noi bo), khac chu de dich (truy xuat nguon goc thuc pham) - it lien quan truc tiep
Tieu de rat giong nhau (danh sach don vi su nghiep truc thuoc Bo TTTT) - mau danh sach duoc cap nhat dinh ky thay the ban cu
Noi dung trich chi la dieu khoan chuyen tiep chung chung, khong xac nhan duoc co lien quan dich cu the hay khong
TIEU DE NGUON neu dich ich 282/2025/NĐ-CP theo ten - bang chung tuong minh DeepSeek da bo qua (loi tim kiem chi quet noi dung, khong quet tieu de)
Ly do DeepSeek dua ra bi loi copy-paste vo nghia; chu de (bao cao dinh ky vs an ninh hang khong) co the khac nhau that hoac co lien quan qua yeu cau bao cao
Cung nguon voi ca 124607 khac, tieu de hanh chinh khac chu de khuyen nong cua dich
Dieu 1 nguon ve to chuc giam dinh so huu tri tue - truc tiep lien quan chu de SHTT cua dich, DeepSeek bo qua bang chung nay
Noi dung trich la dieu khoan hanh chinh chung (trach nhiem thi hanh), khong xac nhan rieng chu de phong chay chua chay rung
Cung nam 2005, cung to chuc (Nha may dien/Nhiet dien Ba Ria), cung muc dich chuyen doi - rat co the la 2 quyet dinh lien tiep ve cung 1 viec
Cung nguon 124607, tieu de hanh chinh khac chu de kiem tra ATTP dong vat NK cua dich
Giong 164789 khac, noi dung trich la dieu khoan hanh chinh chung, khong xac nhan rieng truy xuat lam san
Cung nguon 124607, tieu de hanh chinh khac chu de kiem tra ATTP thuc vat NK cua dich

Noi dung trich (Dieu 19 Van phong thuoc Bo - cap Bo) khong khop cap huyen cua dich - dau hieu khac cap, it lien quan
Nguon ban hanh he thong muc luc ngan sach MOI toan dien (nhieu phu luc danh muc ma so) - loai tai ban toan dien thay the cac sua doi truoc do
Cung nguon voi 24008 khac, cung ly do he thong muc luc ngan sach moi thay the huong dan cu

Nguon la quyet dinh cong bo danh muc VB het hieu luc 2000-2004 cua Bo TM - dich khop tieu chi (BTM, nam 2000) du khac chu de noi dung
Dieu trich (quy hoach thoat nuoc) khac chu de dich (nghia trang/hoa tang) nhung nguon sua nhieu NĐ ha tang cung luc, khong loai tru dieu khac ve nghia trang
TIEU DE NGUON neu dich ich theo ten ro rang; 2 dieu trich duoc (LPG, thiet bi dien) thuoc 2 TT khac trong cung nguon (10/2012, 11/2012), dieu danh cho dich (thep) khong duoc trich
